description: This file manages the lifecycle and state of subagent runs, including registration, recovery, event handling, and cleanup within a distributed agent system.

methods.name: loadSubagentRegistryRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the runtime module for subagent registry.

methods.name: ensureSubagentRegistryPluginRuntimeLoaded
methods.description: Ensures that runtime plugins for the subagent registry are loaded, loading them if necessary.

methods.name: resolveSubagentRegistryContextEngine
methods.description: Resolves the context engine for the subagent registry based on current configuration.

methods.name: persistSubagentRuns
methods.description: Persists current subagent runs to disk.

methods.name: clearPendingLifecycleError
methods.description: Clears scheduled lifecycle error for a specific run.

methods.name: schedulePendingLifecycleError
methods.description: Schedules a lifecycle error to be handled after a delay.

methods.name: notifyContextEngineSubagentEnded
methods.description: Notifies the context engine that a subagent has ended.

methods.name: suppressAnnounceForSteerRestart
methods.description: Checks if an announce should be suppressed due to steer restart reason.

methods.name: shouldKeepThreadBindingAfterRun
methods.description: Determines if thread binding should be kept after a run ends.

methods.name: shouldEmitEndedHookForRun
methods.description: Determines if the ended hook should be emitted for a run.

methods.name: emitSubagentEndedHookForRun
methods.description: Emits the subagent ended hook with appropriate parameters.

methods.name: resumeSubagentRun
methods.description: Resumes a subagent run, handling orphaned or expired runs.

methods.name: restoreSubagentRunsOnce
methods.description: Restores subagent runs from disk once during startup.

methods.name: resolveSubagentWaitTimeoutMs
methods.description: Calculates wait timeout for subagent based on config and run parameters.

methods.name: startSweeper
methods.description: Starts periodic cleanup of archived runs.

methods.name: sweepSubagentRuns
methods.description: Performs cleanup of runs that are due for archiving.

methods.name: ensureListener
methods.description: Sets up event listener for lifecycle events.
